'''Andrew Wannop''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[March 2001 Vancouver tournament]] on 3 March 2001 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|CCT Ties]], according to Alan Sagan's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1833">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-04-vancouver-bc-03-03-01d1833/ vancouver-bc-03-03-01], DeckTech (Alan "Serpent" Sagan, 4 March 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-03-04-vancouver-bc-03-03-01d1833/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
